articles.title: How the House Financial Services Committee is taking on tokenization: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Rep. French Hill, head of the House Financial Services Committee, weighed in on outstanding policy issues in an interview with CoinDesk last month.

articles.title: How Stellar became part of DTCC's tokenization push for Wall Street securities onchain
articles.snippet: Wall Street's clearing giant chose a public blockchain with compliance tools built for regulated assets, Stellar Development Foundation CEO Denelle Dixon said.

articles.title: The institutional edge: moomoo targets Wall Street-grade trading tools for retail crypto investors
articles.snippet: The brokerage giant says the future of investing won’t be defined by asset access alone but by the quality of tools investors get.

articles.title: Bitcoin's wild days are over — and Trace Mayer says that's a good thing
articles.snippet: The creator of the Mayer Multiple argues bitcoin’s growing economic substance is compressing volatility and attracting deeper capital.

articles.title: XRP Ledger's new proposal blocks the flash loan attacks costing DeFi hundreds of millions
articles.snippet: A draft XRPL amendment notes that flash loan attacks are "structurally impossible" on the network because of how its transactions are built, an architectural quirk that has spared the chain from the exploit class that has cost Ethereum DeFi billions.
